Fence Wizards

Temporary Fence Rental Questions

Practical answers about quotes, installation, fence types, service, and pickup.

Request a quoteCall Richard(317) 296-4015

Pricing & payment

What information do you need for a quote?

The project location, fence type, approximate linear footage, gates, and rental duration. Rough measurements are fine for the first conversation.

Do you charge monthly rent?

The quote is a flat fee for the agreed term. Standard rentals cover up to 12 months, and short jobs receive discounted pricing.

Does the quote include removal?

Yes. Delivery, installation, and removal are included in the quote.

What if the project takes longer?

A schedule slip within the agreed term does not change the rental price. Call before the term ends if you need an extension. Changes in scope should be discussed with Richard.

What are the payment terms?

Established and vetted accounts can use Net 30. Smaller or unvetted accounts pay up front. Richard confirms which applies at the start.

Are there damage fees?

Fence Wizards does not charge excessive damage fees. Tell Richard about damage so he can discuss the work required.

How quickly can I get a price?

Richard can provide a verbal quote on the phone when the project details are available. A written proposal follows.

Installation & service

How soon can you install?

The normal installation window is 24–48 hours. Confirm the date with Richard, especially for an urgent job.

Do you handle emergency fencing?

Yes. Call with the location and situation. Timing depends on the site, current jobs, and available equipment.

Can you work overnight for an event?

Yes. Setup and pickup can follow your load-in and load-out schedule, including overnight or before dawn.

Can a gate or fence run be moved?

Yes. General contractors receive same-day service for changes on existing sites. Your crew can also move individual portable panels.

Who installs the fence?

Our own crew. Richard works with his father and brother, using the company’s trucks and material.

When can I call?

7:30 a.m. to 9 p.m., seven days a week. Richard handles the calls.

Fence types & site conditions

What is the difference between panels and driven fencing?

Panels sit in weighted stands and can move as the layout changes. Post-driven chain link uses posts driven into the ground for a more fixed perimeter.

Do you have eight-foot fencing?

Yes, in both systems. Request it early so availability can be confirmed.

Can you install on concrete or asphalt?

Panels and stands work above the ground, making them suitable for paved sites.

Do you provide pedestrian and drive gates?

Yes. Tell us where people and deliveries need access.

Is windscreen rented or sold?

Sold. Plain and printed windscreen remain yours after the rental fence comes down.

Can you print our company logo or sponsor graphics?

Yes. Discuss the artwork, dimensions, and deadline when requesting the quote.

Can we rent barricades without fencing?

Yes. Barricades are available as a separate rental for indoor or outdoor events.

Coverage & the business

Where do you work?

The Indianapolis metro and roughly 80 miles around downtown Indianapolis, from our base in Greenwood. Check the service-area pages or send your project address.

Does distance affect the quote?

Yes. Travel to sites near the edge of the coverage area is accounted for in the quote and discussed with you.

What if we are outside the listed area?

Call with the address. Richard can tell you whether the job can be served.

Are you insured?

Yes. Coverage includes umbrella, general liability, commercial auto, and workers compensation. Ask for certificates needed for your project.

Do you install residential or permanent fencing?

No. Fence Wizards focuses on temporary fencing for commercial construction, events, and restoration. Permanent installation, repairs, gate automation, and residential fencing are not offered.

Who will handle my inquiry?

Richard Warren, the owner.
